pageProps.title: Oreno Ramen Main Branch
pageProps.review: This is a visit review of tasting Tori-Paitan Ramen with rich and savory chicken broth at Oreno Ramen Main Branch in Hapjeong, and enjoying the unlimited refill service for noodles and rice.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Tori-Paitan Ramen", "rating": 5 } --- A rich and savory ramen based on chicken broth. ``` ## Review Maybe because it moved to a new, expanded location, there was less waiting than last time. There is no Catch Table system; you just order first at the kiosk, get a waiting number, and wait for your turn. You can add toppings, but I didn't add any separately because rice, noodles, and broth can be refilled indefinitely. The noodles have a slightly firm texture. Of course, I added rice and ate it all, even the broth. I hesitated after seeing the next table refilling broth and noodles, but I held back because I thought I would overeat. Next time, I'll try the red broth too! ## Pictures
